[ Frostbite ]: Each stack grants the enemy DMG Bonus -10% and Ignore CRIT Rate -1%, and deals Ice DMG equal to 50% of the protagonist's ATK per round. Stacks up to 10 times.
battle_skills.Lv2 (pet lv 20+):
Casts a skill every 2 rounds, dealing 3 instances of Ice DMG equal to 80% of the protagonist's ATK. Each hit has a 60% chance to inflict 1 stack of [ Frostbite ]. At max [ Frostbite ] stacks, Pingu's DMG has a 35% chance to the enemy for 1 round (1 trigger per 4 rounds).

[ Frostbite ]: Each stack: DMG Bonus -10%, Ignore CRIT Rate -1%; deals Ice DMG equal to 75% of ATK per round. Stacks up to 10.
Freeze: Prevents enemy action. Not affected by Freeze Immunity.
battle_skills.Lv3 (pet lv 40+):
Casts a skill every 2 rounds, dealing 3 instances of Ice DMG (80% ATK), each with 60% chance to inflict [ Frostbite ]. At max stacks, 35% chance to freeze enemy for 1 round (1 per 4 rounds).

[ Frostbite ]: DMG Bonus -10%, Ignore CRIT Rate -1%, ATK -4%; Ice DMG equal to 100% of ATK per round. Stacks up to 10.
battle_skills.Lv4 (pet lv 60+):
Casts a skill every 2 rounds, dealing 3 instances of Ice DMG (80% ATK). At max [ Frostbite ] stacks, 35% chance to freeze for 1 round (1 per 4 rounds).

[ Frostbite ]: DMG Bonus -10%, Ignore CRIT Rate -1%, ATK -4%, Final DMG Reduction -2%; deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of ATK per round. Stacks up to 10.
battle_skills.Lv5 (pet lv 80+):
Casts a skill every 2 rounds. At max [ Frostbite ] stacks, 50% chance to freeze for 1 round (1 per 4 rounds), and Pingu's DMG gains Ignore Control Immunity +50%.

[ Frostbite ]: DMG Bonus -10%, Ignore CRIT Rate -1%, ATK -4%, Final DMG Reduction -2%; deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of ATK per round. Stacks up to 10.

awaken_effects.A0:
Casts a skill every 2 rounds. At max [ Frostbite ] stacks, 50% chance to freeze for 1 round (1 per 2 rounds). After [ Frostbite ] is fully stacked, enemy Final DMG Bonus -20%, and Pingu's DMG gains Ignore Control Immunity +50%.

[ Frostbite ]: DMG Bonus -10%, Ignore CRIT Rate -1%, ATK -4%, Final DMG Reduction -2%; deals Ice DMG equal to 100% of ATK per round. Stacks up to 10.
awaken_effects.A1: Pingu's DMG coefficient increased to 100%, and the chance to inflict [ Frostbite ] is increased to 100%.
awaken_effects.A4: Each of Pingu's hits inflicts +1 stack of [ Frostbite ].
awaken_effects.A10: The enemy DMG Bonus reduction per stack of [ Frostbite ] is increased to 20%.
